{{Quote|He told me where I could find the Mandalore's helmet, and that I must take it and reassemble the clans. When I asked him why he told me nothing, only that I should wait for him to return and be ready for it.|[[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore the Preserver]], about [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" />}}
The '''Mandalorians''' under [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore the Preserver]] were a group of Mandalorian warriors reunited after the [[Jedi Civil War]] under the banner of [[Clan Ordo]]. Made up of many survivors of the Mandalorian Wars and some newcomers,<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" /> the group was motivated towards reestablishing the Mandalorian identity and ultimately regain their place in the galaxy.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />

==History==
{{Quote|I thought the Mandalorians were disbanded.''"<br />"''Scattered, perhaps, but we're still alive. Alive and rebuilding.|[[Meetra Surik]] and [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore the Preserver]]|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" />}}
After the [[Mandalorian Wars]] concluded above the planet [[Malachor V]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] survivors once again scattered across space. Some returned to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] and even more became soldiers for hire, becoming known as [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] mercenaries.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Unlike their predecessors these warriors were mostly concerned with earning a living, and as such worked without regard for honor or morals.<ref name="SWInsider">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref>

Due to his help in defeating [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], the warrior and mercenary [[Canderous Ordo]] [[Search for Mandalore's Mask|received]] the traditional [[Mandalore's Mask|mask of Mandalore]] from the former Sith Lord [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]. Canderous began a quest of reuniting the surviving Mandalorians and restoring their honor. During this task, he met an ill [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] who claimed to be the true Mandalore, calling [[Mandalore the Ultimate]] a usurper with ties to the Sith. Before dying the Taung gave Canderous his armor and handed over his clan, asking Canderous to preserve the old ways. Canderous accepted the Taung's request, and integrated the mask into the helmet and began wearing the armor as '''Mandalore the Preserver'''.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" /> Mandalore reclaimed the abandoned [[Mandalorian Outpost (Dxun)|outpost]] previously used by the Mandalorian forces during the war, and used it as headquarters for his rebuilding effort.

Five years after the Jedi Civil War, Meetra Surik was forced to land on Dxun by [[Tobin (Human)|Colonel Tobin's]] space forces when searching for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kavar]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. She was found by a Mandalorian sentry and taken to the Mandalorian base. Mandalore agreed to give her safe passage to Onderon if she proved herself worthy. After completing various tasks, such as stopping Tobin's scouts from uncovering the base and rescuing the lost warrior [[Kumus]], Mandalore agreed to help her. Shortly before they could leave, however, [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]], who had been tracking her progress since an incident on [[Peragus II|Peragus]], [[Skirmish on Dxun|attacked]] the base. Surik helped defend the base from the invaders before leaving.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" />

[[File:Telos_mandshuttle.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Mandalorian warriors board the [[Ravager (Centurion-class)|''Ravager'']] with [[Meetra Surik]] and her companions onboard.]]
After their business on Onderon was done, Mandalore stated that he would accompany Surik on her journey for two reasons; the Sith would eventually dominate the Mandalorians if they were allowed to defeat the Jedi once and for all, and he had been meaning to leave to search for more clans. He found such clans on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. When the [[Battle of Telos IV]] began, the Mandalorians helped battle against the Sith, particularly aiding in the destruction of the [[Ravager (Centurion-class)|Ravager]], [[Darth Nihilus]]' personal vessel.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" /> Having restored much of their honor in the battle, the Mandalorians began reestablishing their place in the galaxy again.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />

==Armor and Equipment==
Although [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore]] didn't reintroduce the same hierarchy as the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]], all known warriors he managed to draw in used [[Neo-Crusader armor]]. The golden armor of the [[Field Marshal/Legends|Field Marshals]] was used by the drill instructor [[Xarga]] and the champion of the [[Battle Circle]] [[Bralor]]. Mandalore's right hand man [[Kelborn]] on the other hand used the crimson armor of the [[Rally Master]]s, as did a [[Mandalorian Guard Captain|guard captain]] and a [[Mandalorian sergeant|sergeant]] in the camp.

They had at least one [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]], which had been salvaged from the war. This type of droid resembled a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] more than a [[Droid/Legends|droid]], and it was modified to allow three people to fly in it. They also frequently used a [[G-Type light shuttle]], which [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore]] used to take [[Meetra Surik]] to [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" />

==Behind the scenes==
The banner used by the Mandalorians under Clan Ordo is similar to that of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]].

In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', during the attack where [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith Assassins]] invade the camp, it is possible for any of the named Mandalorians to die as a corpse if their health is extremely low and they are damaged several times.
